title: India's Supreme Court Rejects CBI Inquiry into Bharat Tivari Encounter
summary: The Indian Supreme Court has rejected a petition seeking a Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) inquiry into the encounter of Bharat Tivari, a former police officer. The court allowed Tivari to appeal to the High Court instead. This decision has sparked debate over the handling of the case and the role of the CBI.
summary_points: The Supreme Court rejected a petition seeking a CBI inquiry into Bharat Tivari's encounter.
Tivari was shot dead by police in 2019, sparking controversy over the circumstances surrounding his death.
The court allowed Tivari to appeal to the High Court instead of granting a CBI inquiry.
This decision has raised questions about the handling of the case and the role of the CBI in investigating police encounters.
Tivari's family and supporters have called for a thorough investigation into his death.
